fields.summary_ko.0: Seagate Technology (NASDAQ:STX) exceeded guidance in Q1 of the fiscal year with revenue of $4.2B (up 61% YoY), record non-GAAP EPS of $7.68, and operating margin of 50.7%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Data center revenue of $3.4B (81% of total revenue) was the core growth driver, and guidance for the December quarter indicated revenue of $4.8B and non-GAAP EPS of $9.20.
fields.summary_ko.2: Data center revenue increased 18% QoQ and 63% YoY, with cloud proximity products achieving 12 consecutive quarters of growth, driven by expanding AI data storage demand.
